description: Severity uses inconsistent capitalisation: row 5 (PAT3005, Osteoporosis) has 'mild' (all lower) and row 18 (PAT3018, Arthritis) has 'SEVERE' (all upper), while all other rows use Title Case ('Mild','Moderate','Severe','Critical'). Triage priority filters will miss these two patients.
business_context: Hospital EHR system. Severity label inconsistency corrupts automated triage prioritisation and clinical dashboard filtering.
